title: Re-enable WhatsApp message capture + /api/logout in the Go bridge, rebundle sidecar
scope:
The desktop-embedded whatsapp-bridge (Go, tools/whatsapp-bridge/main.go) deliberately does 'send + QR + health only. No message reading/mirroring.' (main.go:14). Handlers registered at main.go:232-235 are only /api/send, /api/health, /api/qr. This unit makes the desktop bridge CANONICAL (Option A, user-approved): add live message capture so reads stay fresh, plus a logout endpoint for re-auth.

DO:
1. Add a whatsmeow message-capture event handler: client.AddEventHandler for *events.Message, writing captured messages into a `messages` table (and a `chats` table for chat names) IN THE SAME sqlite store (modernc sqlite DSN at main.go:183, store = app_data_dir/whatsapp/whatsapp.db). CRITICAL: the schema MUST match what tools/whatsapp-sync/sync.mjs reads (sync.mjs:79-91) so the sync SQL needs zero changes — columns: messages(id, chat_jid, sender, content, timestamp, is_from_me, ...), chats(jid, name). Use lharries/whatsapp-mcp main.go as the reference implementation for the exact table DDL + insert + the events.Message->row mapping (id, chat jid, sender, text content, timestamp, is_from_me).
2. Add POST /api/logout that calls client.Logout(ctx) so the store's device ID is cleared and whatsmeow re-enters the QR pairing flow (QR fires on logged-out store per main.go:199). Keep it consistent with the existing handler registration block (main.go:232-235).
3. Keep /api/send, /api/qr, /api/health working unchanged. Keep the QR stdout events ({"event":"qr"}/{"event":"ready"}, main.go:52-76,208-223) intact.
4. Recompile the Go bridge for aarch64-apple-darwin and RE-BUNDLE the sidecar binary into apps/desktop/src-tauri/binaries/whatsapp-bridge-aarch64-apple-darwin (the repo already cross-compiles this sidecar; find the build script/command). go.mod already has whatsmeow (go.mod:6).

DO NOT change the store path/DSN, the port (8080), or the send/QR behavior. 'Start fresh from now' was chosen: no historical backfill needed.
criteria: The bridge captures incoming (and outgoing) WhatsApp messages live into a `messages` table (+ `chats`) in app_data_dir/whatsapp/whatsapp.db, with columns matching what tools/whatsapp-sync/sync.mjs SELECTs (id, chat_jid, sender, content, timestamp, is_from_me; chats.name) so sync.mjs runs unchanged.
POST /api/logout logs the whatsmeow client out (clears Store.ID) and the existing QR stdout/event flow re-fires for re-pairing.
/api/send, /api/qr, /api/health keep working exactly as before; QR + ready stdout events unchanged.
The Go bridge compiles (`go build`) cleanly, and the aarch64-apple-darwin sidecar binary in apps/desktop/src-tauri/binaries/ is rebuilt from the new source.
No change to the store path, port, or send/QR semantics.
